agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 22, 2020 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the December 11, 2019 Special Closed Session Meeting, December 11, 2019 Special Joint City Council and Planning Commission Meeting, December 11, 2019 Regular Meeting, December 18, 2019 Special Closed Session Meeting, and December 18, 2019 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2020-01-22 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Analyst McShane
Approve the Warrants.
2020-01-22 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Second Reading and adoption of Ordinance No. 2019-28 for amendments to the Downtown Encinitas Specific Plan and the Local Coastal Plan to make changes to the planting palette, location, and planting guidelines within Chapters 4 and 7 of the DESP. Contact Person: Associate Planner Plagemann
Adopt Ordinance No. 2019-28 titled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California Adopting Amendments to the Downtown Encinitas Specific Plan to Address Changes to the Street Tree Guidelines."
2020-01-22 Item 08C Second Reading Amendments to the DESP - Street Tree Guidelines
8D.
Report on the Financial Results for Fiscal Year 2018-19. Contact Person: Finance Manager Gallup
1) Approve and adopt the actual ending fund balances for FY 2018-19 as the beginning fund balances for FY 2019-20; 2) Approve the revised Schedule A, "Revised Budget Summary FY 2019-20;" 3) Receive the Capital Improvement Program End of Year Status Report; and 4) Adopt Resolution 2020-06 authorizing: a) a lump sum payment to CalPERS to reduce the City of Encinitas unfunded pension liability in the amount of $500,000, and b) a fund balance transfer in the amount of $410,000 from the Open Space Acquisition Fees Fund (Fund 235) to the Opportunity Fund (Fund 119), formerly the Special Projects Fund.
2020-01-22 Item 08D Report on the Financial Results for FY 2018-19
8E.
Second Reading and Adoption of Ordinance 2019-30, an Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, amending Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 11.27 – Expanded Polystyrene Disposable Food Service Ware Prohibition Ordinance. Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
Adopt Ordinance 2019-30 titled, “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending Chapter 11.27 of the Encinitas Municipal Code Prohibiting the Use and Distribution of Expanded Polystyrene Food Service Ware, Plastic Utensils, and Beverage Straws.”
2020-01-22 Item 08E Second Reading and Adoption of Ordinance 2019-30
8F.
South Coast Highway 101 Safety and Mobility (CS20E) Construction Contract. Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
1) Authorize the City Manager to execute a contract in substantial form, and any necessary amendments and time extensions, in consultation with the City Attorney, to Blue Pacific Engineering and Construction in the amount of $653,400 plus a 25 percent contingency of $163,350 for a total contract not to exceed amount of $816,750 to construct the South Coast Highway 101 Safety and Mobility Project; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-04, titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Budget” to allocate $431,292 to the South Coast Highway Mobility Project (CS20E).
2020-01-22 Item 08F South Coast Highway 101 Safety and Mobility Construction Contract
8G.
Construction Contract for Pavement Rehabilitation and Overlay Project FY 2018-2019 (CS19A). Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
Authorize the City Manager to execute a contract in substantial form and any necessary amendments and time extensions, in consultation with the City Attorney, with PAL General Engineering, INC. in the amount of $969,833 plus 20 percent contingency $193,967 to construct the Pavement Rehabilitation and Overlay Project FY 2018-2019, for a total construction contract not-to-exceed amount of $1,163,800.
2020-01-22 Item 08G Construction Contract for Pavement Rehabilitation and Overlay Project FY 2018-2019
8H.
Acceptance of the Cardiff Beach Living Shoreline Project (CP16A). Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
Adopt Resolution No. 2020-07 accepting the public improvements for the Cardiff Beach Shoreline Project (CP16A) as complete to the satisfaction of the City; authorizing the filing of the Notice of Completion for the Project; authorizing the release of the payment bond in full upon the recording of the Notice of Completion; and authorizing the release of the performance bond in full one (1) year after the recording of the Notice of Completion.
2020-01-22 Item 08H Cardiff Beach Living Shoreline Project Acceptance
8I.
City of Encinitas Quality Assurance Plan for project construction. Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
Review and approve the Quality Assurance Plan (QAP) in substantial form as provided in Attachment 1 of the agenda report for project construction.
2020-01-22 Item 08I City of Encinitas Quality Assurance Plan for Project Construction
8J.
Emergency Repairs to Highway 101 Bridge over the San Elijo Lagoon (CX20A). Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
1) Ratify Emergency Contract CX20A; 2) Ratify Emergency Contract CX20A Change Order No 1; 3) Amend the Fiscal Years 2019-20 and 2020-21 Operating Budget; 4) Accept public improvements as complete; 5) Authorize filing of Notice of Completion; 6) Authorize release of payment bond in full upon the recording of the Notice of Completion; and 7) Authorize the release of the performance bond in full one (1) year after the recording of the Notice of Completion.
2020-01-22 Item 08J San Elijo Hwy 101 Emerrgency Bridge Repairs
8K.
Reject all bids and rebid the Moonlight State Beach Playground Replacement Project PR-RFB-19-05. Contact Person: Park Operations Manager Saul
1) Reject all bids from the bid opening for the Moonlight State Beach Playground Replacement Project PR-RFB-19-05; and 2) Authorize staff to re-advertise and re-bid the Moonlight State Beach Playground Replacement Project.
2020-01-22 Item 08K Reject All Bids and Rebid the Moonlight State Beach Playground Replacement Project
8L.
City Hall Renovation Project (CF20C). Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
Approve the plans, specifications, and authorization to advertise the City Hall Renovation Project (CF20C).
2020-01-22 Item 08L City Hall Renovation
8M.
Leaf Blower Rebate Program. Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
1) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2020-05, entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Budget” to allocate $10,000 for the Leaf Blower Rebate Program; and 2) Extend the Leaf Blower Rebate Program to May 1, 2020.
2020-01-22 Item 08M Leaf Blower Rebate Program Budget Request
8N.
Contract Amendment #4 for Infrastructure Engineering Corporation (IEC) to Provide Additional Design and Permitting Services on Olivenhain Trunk Sewer Project (CC04J). Contact Person: Senior Engineer Widelski
Authorize the City Manager to execute a contract amendment and time extensions, in consultation with the City Attorney, with Infrastructure Engineering Corporation (IEC) in the amount of $407,192 plus 15 percent contingency for a not-to-exceed amount of $468,271 to perform additional design and permitting services for the Olivenhain Trunk Sewer Project.
2020-01-22 Item 08N Contract Amendment #4 Infrastructure Engineering Corporation - Olivenhain Trunk Sewer Project (CC04J)
8O.
Sump and Inlet Project (CD17A & CD05E). Contact Person: Senior Engineer Widelski
Authorize the City Manager to execute a construction contract in substantial form and any necessary amendments and time extensions, in consultation with the City Attorney, with Blue Pacific Engineering & Construction Inc. in the amount of $124,200 plus 15 percent contingency of $18,630 for a total contract amount not to exceed $142,830 to construct the Sump (CD17A) and Inlet Project (CD05E).
2020-01-22 Item 08O Sump and Inlet Project
8P.
County of San Diego Contract Number 561722 Agreement with the City of Encinitas for the Senior Nutrition Program. Contact Person: Senior Center Manager Goodsell
1) Authorize the City Manager to execute Contract Number 561722, with the County of San Diego, in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, in conjunction with the City Attorney accepting grant reimbursement funding for the Senior Nutrition Program not to exceed $25,270 for the five (5) months, February 1, 2020 through June 30, 2020; and 2) Authorize the City Manager to execute all future amendments through June 30, 2023, in conjunction with the City Attorney and subject to budget appropriations, accepting grant reimbursement funding for the Senior Nutrition Program for a total not to exceed $207,226.
2020-01-22 Item 08P County of San Diego Contract Number 561722 - Senior Nutrition Program
8Q.
Letter of support for the continued funding of the Coastal Data Information Program. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
Approve the attached letter of support for the Coastal Data Information Program (CDIP).
2020-01-22 Item 08Q Letter of Support for the Continued Funding of the Coastal Data Information Program
8R.
Fiscal Year 2019-20 First Quarter Budget Status Report and Proposed Budget Amendments. Contact Person: Finance Manager Gallup
1) Receive and file the Fiscal Year 2019-20 First Quarter Budget Status Report; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-08 titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Budget."
2020-01-22 Item 08R First Quarter Budget Status Report

ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.

10A.
Jewish Family Service (JFS) request to operate a Safe Parking Program at Leichtag Commons located at 441 Saxony Road for a maximum of 25 vehicles accommodating households living in their cars. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-03 "Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Confirming the Existence of a Shelter Crisis and Taking Actions to Approve the Establishment of a Safe Parking Program;" 2) Approve the Lease Agreement between City of Encinitas and LF Encinitas Properties, LLC ("Leichtag Foundation") in substantial form, subject to review and final approval by City Attorney, for the purpose of leasing a portion of Leichtag Commons to provide a Safe Parking Program Lot, and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement; and 3) Approve the Use Agreement between City of Encinitas and Jewish Family Service, as attached in substantial form, subject to review and final approval by City Attorney, for the purpose of operating a Safe Parking Program, and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement.

Direct staff to draft modifications to Encinitas Municipal Code which could be adopted to explicitly allow for the use of parking lots for approved Safe Parking Programs.

ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT CITY COUNCIL MEETING IS A SPECIAL MEETING ON JANUARY 29, 2020 AT THE ENCINITAS COMMUNITY CENTER. THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON FEBRUARY 12, 2020
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
